name: Viking Lander 2
about: Viking Lander 2 (1975-083C, LARCN), launched 1975 Sep  9. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Mars. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
